name: Django
description: Project-level Python web framework, installed into a per-project virtual environment.
longDescription: Django is a Python framework that belongs inside individual projects, not on the operating system. DevForge treats it as a project recipe: it ensures a supported Python runtime is present and gives you the exact commands to create an isolated virtual environment and a new Django project.
caveats: Django is installed per project inside a virtual environment, not globally.
DevForge does not create or modify project files; it provides the verified setup commands.

dependencies.reason: Django requires Python 3.11 or newer and is installed into a project virtual environment.

projectRecipe.summary: Create a Python virtual environment and install Django inside it for this project only.

commands.label: Create and activate a virtual environment

notes: Run these commands in your project folder, not in the DevForge tools directory.
Virtual environment activation may require adjusting the PowerShell execution policy for your user.
